MDA allows the generation of DNA for comparative genotyping of Pasteuria penetrants biotypes, and detection of SNPs in spoIIAB indicates infection by more that one genotype.

(1) MDA is a useful method for generating genomic DNA of Pasteuria spp., (2) MDA allows detection of SNP variation in genes that are conserved among Pasteuria species, (3) SNP variation in genes is present among Pasteuria species and among Pasteuria biotypes, (4) SNP variation can be used to identify Pasteuria biotypes in individual infected nematodes, and (5) MDA allows quantitative PCR-based detection of Pasteuria spp.

the development and use of MDA for comparative genomics and the identification of genes associated host specificity in P. penetrans.

the development of a genotyping system that can be used to study the diversity of Pasteuria species infecting different nematode hosts and that can be applied to identify the most virulent biotype for use as a biocontrol agent.
